features.notes: 73 keys E1–E7 (MIDI 28–100), 43 white / 30 black, standard octave pattern, uniform white grid and offset black keys, 0.61 black-key height fraction.
Six ordered sections at 13/21/15/9/21/21% widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split via inline styles, continuous single-chassis DOM with rails and end cheeks.
Normalized hardware model with unique stable IDs; nine organ drawbars; primary OLEDs only in Program and Synth; section-scoped landmark and density assertions.

Pointer down/up/cancel/lost-capture, independent multi-touch pointer ownership, focused-key Enter operation with repeat suppression, window-blur release, visible depression via data-pressed/aria-pressed.

Knobs/encoders/faders/drawbars/wheels/stick/buttons move by pointer and keyboard and update only presentation state; tests prove no AudioContext is created and no playing voices change from panel interaction.
Every control exposes the modeled accessible name, correct role, value min/max/now, toggle state where latching, focusability, and end-to-end keyboard operation.
No marketing hero or headings, no rendered reference photograph, keybed inside chassis, all 73 keys within bounds, six sections summing to 100%, 54+46 partition.
Lazy start, ready state with a real path to the destination, repeated/overlapping notes, release, all-notes-off, node/timer cleanup back to a stable count.
Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keys with repeat suppression and blur cleanup, space-bar sustain, MIDI note/velocity/CC64/hot-plug/disconnect/denied/unsupported.
Sustain transitions, 24-voice polyphony, deterministic oldest-first stealing, monotonic velocity-to-level response, cleanup of stolen and released voices.
Truthful idle/loading/ready/fallback/error status, blur/MIDI-disconnect/unmount all-notes-off cleanup through internal paths only (the visible Panic button stays decorative).
